title: 12 Best Rooftop Bars in Kuala Lumpur

venues.name: Marini's on 57
venues.address: Level 57, Menara 3, Petronas, Persiaran KLCC, KL, 50088
venues.verdict: The undisputed king of KL rooftop bars. 57th floor, eye-level with the Petronas Twin Towers, world-class cocktails.

venues.name: SkyBar
venues.address: Level 33, Traders Hotel, KL City Centre, 50088
venues.verdict: KL's most iconic party rooftop - glowing infinity pool, Twin Tower views, DJ nights.

venues.name: Helipad KL
venues.address: Level 34, Menara KH, Jln Sultan Ismail, Bukit Bintang, 50450
venues.verdict: The most unique rooftop in KL - drinking on an actual helipad with no railings and 360-degree views.

venues.name: Vertigo @ Banyan Tree
venues.address: Level 59, Banyan Tree KL, 2 Jalan Conlay, 50450
venues.verdict: The highest rooftop bar in KL - intimate, romantic atmosphere perfect for couples.

venues.name: Fuego at Troika Sky Dining
venues.address: Level 23A, Tower B, The Troika, Persiaran KLCC, 50450
venues.verdict: Best food-and-drinks combo on any KL rooftop - Latin American cuisine with up-close Petronas Tower views.

venues.name: WET Deck at W KL
venues.address: Level 12, W Hotel, 121 Jln Ampang, KL, 50450
venues.verdict: Best pool-party-meets-rooftop-bar in KL - vibrant energy, Twin Tower backdrop, live DJs.

venues.name: Sky51 at EQ
venues.address: EQ, Equatorial Plaza, Jln Sultan Ismail, KL, 50250
venues.verdict: Asia's Top 5 Rooftop Bar by TimeOut - sleek, modern, bespoke Malaysian-inspired cocktails.

venues.name: Canopy Lounge Rooftop Bar
venues.verdict: The people's champion - highest review count (6,216), highest rating (4.7), most affordable, open until 3 AM.

venues.name: Cielo Rooftop
venues.address: 23-01, VIDA, 1D Jln Ceylon, Bukit Ceylon, 50200 KL
venues.verdict: Rising star in KL's rooftop scene - excellent food, thoughtful cocktails, stunning tower views.

venues.name: Mantra Rooftop Bar
venues.address: Rooftop, Bangsar Village II, Jln Telawi 1, Bangsar, 59100 KL
venues.verdict: Bangsar's best rooftop hangout - neighborhood favorite with great cocktails, shisha, local crowd.

venues.name: Satellite Restaurant & Bar
venues.address: Level 53, Imperial Lexis, 15 Jln Kia Peng, 50450 KL
venues.verdict: Newer addition - 53rd floor 360-degree views from a glass-encased skyscraper with artisan cocktails.

venues.name: Stratosphere @ The Roof
venues.address: Sky Level, First Ave, Bandar Utama, Petaling Jaya, 47800
venues.verdict: Asia first grassed helipad bar - unique open-air experience in Petaling Jaya.
